250-779-1479-5413-8337.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5413-8337.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5413-8337.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, M'Ress and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, M'Ress triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

232-413-678.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, adding {R}{R}{R} and untapping Blasting Station
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Urabrask.
When Priest of Urabrask dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

765-2645-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Guildless Commons.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Guildless Commons's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

5070-5900-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
5070-5900-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

141-653-5231.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-653-5231.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding {R}.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4125-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
4125-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Shipwreck Dowser and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Shipwreck Dowser and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
4125-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Shipwreck Dowser and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

967-3809-3899-6441-7087.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3899-4550-5567-7824--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3899-4550-5567-7824--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

849-1580-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4289-7175-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4289-7175-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4289-7175-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

997-6528-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2366-4178-5702-6968.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control a Forest that does not have summoning sickness and that enters the battlefield untapped.
2366-4178-5702-6968.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa, Who Shakes the World triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.

1418-1651-2638-4935-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1418-1651-2638-4935-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1418-1651-2638-4935-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tireless Tracker triggers twice due to Virtue of Knowledge, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

6431-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

855-1491-5268-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-3263-4565.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-3263-4565.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

671-3097-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

372-2417-2493.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Archaeomancer exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
372-2417-2493.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1987-2187-4423-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least four Islands.
1987-2187-4423-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Possessed Skaab.
When Possessed Skaab and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.

304-1912-4131.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
304-1912-4131.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Tough Cookie's first activated ability by paying {2}{G}, making Basalt Monolith a 4/4 artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

654-1541-2239-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ardent Elementalist, adding {R}.
When Ardent Elementalist dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ardent Elementalist on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Ardent Elementalist from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating six tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Ardent Elementalist and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers six times and Ardent Elementalist triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

643-3575-5150.notablePrerequisites:
There is a creature with flying on the battlefield.
Aerie Ouphes does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-3575-5150.description:
Activate Aerie Ouphes by sacrifcing it, targeting any creature with flying.
When Aerie Ouphes dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with no -1/-1 counter on it due to Bramblewood Paragon and Maskwood Nexus.
Repeat.
Resolve all Aerie Ouphes abilities, destroying the targetted creature(s).
